title: The Pianist's Lament
text: We wandered into the skeleton of an abandoned theater, its air thick with forgotten breath. As we crept through its crumbling halls, a piano melody began to drift—low, haunting, almost imperceptible...

title: The Phantom Warning
text: I was trying to get to sleep when the temperature in the room plummeted. A tall, shadowed figure stood at the foot of my bed, whispering a date I will never forget.

title: Whispers in the Fog
text: Walking past Highgate Cemetery during a thick night fog, three distinct voices called out my name from behind the locked iron gates. Nobody was inside.

title: The Crying Shadow
text: A dark figure was kneeling on the stairs of the old pub, sobbing quietly. When I stepped closer to offer help, it passed straight through the wooden step and vanished.

title: The Red Footsteps
text: Wet footprints appeared on the carpet leading toward my wardrobe, one by one, with absolute silence. The door was locked from the inside.

title: The Uninvited Guest
text: Every night at exactly 10 PM, the rocking chair in the attic begins to move steadily. Last night, I saw the indentation of a person sitting on the cushion.
